decisions.title: Add strength field for transcript highlighting
decisions.text: FR-5 requires the results page to show 'clearly highlighted strong vs. weak spans' in the transcript, but FeedbackItem/generateSessionSummary/results page had no such signal. Added FeedbackItem.strength ('strong'|'weak'), had the summary prompt emit it per feedback item, and highlighted each spokenQuote match inline in the transcript panel (success/danger tokens) on the results page.

decisions.title: SSRF and path-traversal fixes in T-5 backend routes
decisions.text: Independent review of T-5 backend routes found two real vulnerabilities, both fixed: (1) extractTextFromUrl in apps/server/src/lib/extractText.ts did a raw fetch() on the user-supplied jdLink with no validation, allowing SSRF against internal/metadata addresses -- fixed with assertPublicHttpUrl (protocol allowlist + DNS lookup + private/reserved IP block + no redirect-follow; DNS-rebinding TOCTOU accepted as a documented ponytail limitation). (2) frame.ts wrote uploaded frame files to disk keyed by the raw :id route param before verifying the session existed, allowing path traversal / arbitrary file write -- fixed by rejecting any :id that isn't alnum-only before multer runs.

decisions.title: Migrate to GA OpenAI Realtime API (client_secrets + calls)
decisions.text: OpenAI retired the beta /v1/realtime/sessions endpoint on 2026-05-12 (OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1 removed), which broke the interview flow (404 Invalid URL, surfaced to users as 'Failed to start the interview session.'). Migrated: apps/server/src/lib/realtime.ts now calls POST /v1/realtime/client_secrets with the new nested session.audio.input/output body and reads value/expires_at (no more client_secret wrapper); apps/server/src/lib/openai.ts REALTIME_MODEL changed from deprecated gpt-4o-realtime-preview to gpt-realtime; apps/web/.../interview/page.tsx SDP offer now POSTs to /v1/realtime/calls (no ?model= query param) instead of the retired /v1/realtime. Verified live: POST /api/sessions/:id/realtime-token now returns a valid ek_... client secret.

decisions.title: Google sign-in, per-user data, and Settings page
decisions.text: User directed (2026-09-14) a scope expansion beyond SPEC-1's no-auth design: require Google sign-in for all /api/sessions routes, give sessions an owning userId with ownership checks on every per-session route, and add a Settings page storing profile (from Google), a saved resume, default target role and seniority, and the Realtime interviewer voice. Chosen mechanism: Google Identity Services ID token verified server-side with google-auth-library, then an httpOnly SameSite=Lax HMAC-signed session cookie (no OAuth redirect flow, no client secret). Pre-existing ownerless sessions are hidden rather than migrated.

decisions.title: shadcn-style design system without Radix; violet primary; class-free token theming
decisions.text: User directed (2026-09-15) a minimalist redesign of all components with consistent shadcn or better components and light+dark themes. Chosen: adopt shadcn's semantic token names (background, foreground, card, muted, muted-foreground, border, input, ring, primary, secondary, accent, destructive, success) and its variant/size component API inside the existing apps/web/src/components/ui kit, keeping NFR-2's single violet accent as --primary and Inter. Not adopted: Radix primitives, class-variance-authority, tailwind-merge, next-themes — every current control is served by native elements, and components use size variants instead of class overrides so no merge utility is needed. Added lucide-react (the icon set shadcn uses) to replace emoji. Theme: tokens on :root, dark overrides under prefers-color-scheme (unless data-theme=light) and data-theme=dark; an inline head script applies the saved localStorage choice before first paint per Next 16's preventing-flash-before-hydration guide. Token names match shadcn so future 'npx shadcn add' components drop in.

decisions.title: Wizard resume upload replaces the saved resume
decisions.text: User directed (2026-09-15): only ask for a resume in the intake wizard if the user has not uploaded one; if they have, offer only a Replace option. To make 'already uploaded' include resumes uploaded in a previous wizard run (not just Settings), POST /api/sessions now also writes an uploaded resume's text and filename to the user's profile, replacing any saved resume. Refines FR-8 (Settings saved resume) and FR-1 (wizard resume step).

decisions.title: Analyze every frame snapshot on upload
decisions.text: User directed (2026-09-16) random-snapshot video analysis via OpenAI starting with the ~2s frame, not full video analysis. POST /:id/frame now runs generateFrameInsight on each uploaded snapshot in the background after responding (was: only the latest frame, at /complete). Results page lists all snapshots with notes. A snapshot taken just before End may still be analyzing when results first load.

decisions.title: Deploy to a free-tier GCP e2-micro VM behind Caddy
decisions.text: User directed (2026-09-16) free hosting; Railway trial ended. Chosen: Google Cloud e2-micro (us-central1-a, Ubuntu 24.04, 30 GB pd-standard, project interview-prep-508610) at https://35-202-116-188.sslip.io. SQLite and uploads stay on the VM disk, so no DB/storage code changes. Caddy (auto Let's Encrypt) routes /api/* and /health to Express :4000 and everything else to Next :3000, keeping one origin so the SameSite=Lax session cookie needs no change. systemd runs both apps. 2 GB swap lets next build fit in 1 GB RAM (~7 min compile). deploy/setup-vm.sh provisions once; deploy/deploy.sh pulls main, npm ci, migrate deploy, builds, restarts. The external IP is ephemeral: stop/start changes it and the sslip.io host.

knowledge.title: Frame capture never fires in dev (Strict Mode latches endingRef)
knowledge.text: Interview page useEffect(() => cleanup, [cleanup]) runs cleanup on React Strict Mode's simulated unmount (Next 16 app router: strict mode on by default), setting endingRef.current=true permanently; the frame timer then skips capture and stops rescheduling, so no FrameCapture rows are saved. Consequence: dashboard thumbnailUrl null and results frame card hidden. Session cmu2skt9a0006b3dklu2ixllh (2026-09-15) had 33 transcript lines and 0 frames. Secondary: first capture waits 20-45s, too late for very short sessions (~48s). Fix: reset endingRef.current=false in that effect's setup; take first capture a few seconds after connect.

tasks.outcome: Monorepo skeleton: npm workspaces root, Next.js apps/web, Express+TS apps/server, packages/shared
Prisma schema (Session, TranscriptEntry, FrameCapture) + SQLite migration
Backend routes: create session (parse+OpenAI), get session, realtime-token, transcript append, frame upload, complete+summary
Shared UI kit (Button, Card, Input, Textarea, FileDropzone, StepIndicator) matching design reference
3-step onboarding wizard wired to POST /api/sessions
Permissions + pre-call screen with getUserMedia preview
Interview/call page: Realtime WebRTC connection, live transcript relay, randomized frame capture
Results/feedback page + backend summary route
README + .env.example + end-to-end manual verification pass
Dashboard/home with session history (should-have, lower priority per SPEC FR-6), reusing the shared UI kit
Sign-in (Google + email/password backup) with per-user session ownership and a Settings page (profile, saved resume, default role/seniority, interviewer voice)

Redesign all web UI components and pages into a minimalist shadcn-style design system (semantic tokens, variant/size components, lucide icons) with light and dark themes and a persistent theme toggle; presentation only, plus fixing the pre-existing react-hooks lint error in the interview page self-scheduling frame-capture callback (same behavior)
Simple minimalist public landing page at / built from the shared UI kit (hero, how-it-works, call to action, light/dark aware); intake wizard moved from / to /new with its links updated

Redesign the /new intake wizard into a focused onboarding layout: vertical step rail (compact progress bar on mobile), a single card per step with header, content and Back/Continue footer, and a practical Welcome checklist instead of repeated marketing; same three FR-1 steps and same submission behavior
App header shows only logo, Dashboard and New interview; Settings, theme toggle and Sign out move into a native-popover account menu opened from the profile avatar; shared signOut helper

AI stays in English at all times: interviewer instructions forbid switching languages even if the candidate does, input transcription is pinned to English, and question-plan and feedback generation always write English regardless of resume/JD language

Results page: on large screens both columns share one fixed height so the AI feedback card ends level with the transcript card, with transcript and feedback lists scrolling inside their cards; mobile layout unchanged

Intake wizard asks for a resume only when the user has none saved; with a saved resume the Resume step shows it with a Replace option (dropzone hidden until Replace). A resume uploaded in the wizard becomes the user's saved resume, so it is not asked for again.

Interview frame capture works in dev and prod: endingRef is reset when the interview page (re)mounts so React Strict Mode's simulated unmount no longer disables capture, and the first frame is captured ~2s after the voice connection opens (then every 20-45s), so every session gets a dashboard thumbnail and results frame note.
Every interview frame snapshot (first ~2s after connect, then random 20-45s) is analyzed with OpenAI vision when uploaded, and the results page shows each snapshot with its note

App deploys to Railway: API service with a volume holding SQLite and snapshot uploads (UPLOADS_DIR, migrate deploy on start), web service proxying /api to the API over private networking so the session cookie stays first-party

App runs on the GCP e2-micro VM at https://35-202-116-188.sslip.io: Caddy serves HTTPS and routes /api to the Express server and everything else to Next.js (same origin, so the lax session cookie works); SQLite and snapshot uploads stay on the VM disk; deploy/setup-vm.sh provisions the VM once and deploy/deploy.sh redeploys main
